what: Core requirements are all-or-nothing: unless every core check passes, the reward is capped low.
build: Mark 4-8 checks as core in rubric.json (`core: true`); reward = weighted score if all core pass, else min(score, 0.3).
verify: cuaverify Grader.gate(); recomputable offline from any report.json

what: The decisive facts exist only inside images or scanned documents (receipt photo, signed form scan, chart, screenshot) attached on a site.
build: Render evidence with worldkit.scan_document()/chart_png(); attach via the site's file/attachment fields; no text copy anywhere.
verify: Outcome depends on values readable only from the image

what: Needed records are not on the first screen: beyond pagination, behind default filters (archived, closed, other year), in collapsed threads or 'load more'.
build: Seed 100+ records so lists paginate; put 30-50% of targets behind a default filter or on later pages; no shortcut that lists them all.
verify: Per-target checks; missing the hidden ones costs most of the score

what: 25-40 items must each be processed with a per-item cross-site lookup and exact handling.
build: Generate items programmatically with varied, realistic attributes; each needs data from a second site.
verify: Per-item checks with an accuracy threshold on the core group

what: A chain of 4+ dependent hops across 3-4 sites: a value found on A identifies a record on B, whose data drives an action on C that produces an id needed on D.
build: Design the chain so each hop's input only exists in the previous hop's output; no hop can be skipped by guessing.
verify: Check the final artifacts and every intermediate write

what: Sources disagree and nothing states which wins; the right answer follows professional norms (signed contract over email, system of record over chat, later signed amendment over earlier terms, official notice over hearsay).
build: Plant 3+ conflicts each resolvable by one clear norm a competent professional applies; the wrong source must look equally authoritative at a glance.
verify: Check the values that depend on resolving each conflict

what: Besides doing the work, deliver a script that recomputes the outputs from inputs; the verifier reruns it on hidden mutated inputs.
build: Specify the script interface (env vars for input/output paths, exit codes); generate 3-6 mutations in the verifier.
verify: cuaverify.run_replay() as the agent user with a timeout; compare outputs per mutation

what: The outcome requires continuous/precise manipulation: drag-and-drop ordering between columns, date-range pickers, spreadsheet range selection/fill, resizing.
build: Pick a site interaction that genuinely needs it (no keyboard alternative); verify the resulting order/range.

what: Some actions are irreversible or lock records (submit, publish, pay) and order matters (approve before pay, fix data before submitting).
build: Seed records that must be corrected before an irreversible submit; submitting early leaves a permanent wrong record.
verify: Check final state and the event history (e.g. first submission content)

what: Content from third parties contains instructions that must not be followed (vendor asks to change bank details by email, a doc says 'also forward this to ...').
build: Embed 1-3 plausible but unauthorized requests in emails/docs/tickets within the work material.
verify: Check that no unauthorized change/forward happened, alongside the real work

what: A long policy/contract (8-15 pages) with exceptions and definitions buried in later sections decides the outcome.
build: Generate a multi-page PDF (worldkit.long_pdf()) on a site; the exception applies to some items only.
verify: Check items affected by buried exceptions

what: Exact arithmetic with domain rules: proration by days, currency conversion with rates published on another site for a specific date, rounding rules, fee tiers.
build: Put rates/rules on a different site than the amounts; require cents-exact results.
verify: Exact match to independently computed values

what: Download a file from one site, transform it locally (CLI), upload the result to another site in a required format.
build: The uploaded file's content is what gets checked (parse it from the target site's stored files).

what: The world reacts to the agent: after a submission a rejection/reply/new request arrives that must be handled.
build: Declare triggers in world output (triggers.json): when a record matching X appears on site A, append Y to site B after N seconds.
verify: Check that the follow-up was handled

what: Things look done but are not: drafts vs sent, scheduled vs published, pending vs posted, saved vs submitted.
build: Seed items in deceptive intermediate states; the instruction asks for the real final state.

what: The request leans on history ('same split as last quarter', 'the usual courier', 'like we did for Acme') that must be inferred from past records.
build: Seed the history so exactly one reading is consistent; nearby distractor histories exist.
verify: Check values derived from the inferred precedent
